description: This PHP class 'FormatWithSkill' provides a method to format a value by retrieving and returning the name of a Skill entity based on an ID. It uses a SkillService to fetch the Skill object and implements the ValueFormatter interface, indicating it is used for formatting values within the HRM system's maintenance plugin.

classes.name: FormatWithSkill
classes.description: A class implementing value formatting by fetching a Skill's name from the database using its ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the skill by ID and returns its name if the skill exists; otherwise, returns null.

methods.name: getSkillService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of SkillService.
